logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was measured by the shake-flask method [6]. Complex (∼74 kBq in 50 µL) was added to 1.5 mL 1-octanol and 1.5 mL PBS (0.1 M, pH 7.4) in a centrifuge tube, vortexed 1 min at RT, then centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 5 min. Aliquots (0.1 mL) from each phase were counted in a γ counter, and the octanol/PBS ratio was used to compute logD7.4. The octanol phase was repartitioned with fresh PBS (1.0/1.5 mL) until constant values were obtained. Measurements were in triplicate and repeated three times; data are reported as mean ± SD.
